messages:
Nora Blake: quick pitch  launch a micro-ref series: 3 short posts + 1 reference repo + an office-hours drop-in. goal = low-friction dev onramp + measurable bench story.
Ethan Zhou: thumbs up. keep each post <800 words and include runnable snippets.
Riya Patel: i'll draft the first two: quickstart and tuning. Nora, do you want the rollout checklist?
Nora Blake: yes please. also need a small refapp showing routing fallback + a caching example. Mikel can handle the repo?
Mikel: yep. plan: node + python tiny service, two endpoints: /generate (hosted) and /generate?local=1 (local fallback). docker-compose for local.
Ethan Zhou: bench approach: reproducible microbench (3 runs, median). avoid big multiplier claims. include raw CSV and commands. sample command:
```
python microbench.py --model xr-lite --seq 256 --runs 3 --seed 13
```
ContentBot: Reminder: add utm_source=microref&utm_campaign=dev_series to all public links.
Riya Patel: inbound flow: blog CTA -> HubSpot list `microref_series`, tag `devlead`. nurture: 3-email drip (how-to, bench deep-dive, invite).
Nora Blake: timeline: drafts by Thu EOD, repo skeleton by Wed, bench artifacts Mon, schedule office-hours one week after launch. everyone ok?
Mikel: pushing skeleton branch tonight, will include `results/` folder and a small `README_bench.md`.
Ethan Zhou: i'll run CI bench tonight and drop CSVs into the branch. will also include a short reproducibility checklist.
Riya Patel: social assets: hero image + 10s GIF of local fallback + 3 tweet captions. i'll draft copy after seeing GIF.
Nora Blake: publish ops: Riya owns publish + HubSpot wiring. Ethan verifies bench numbers on publish day. Mikel verifies docs build.
Mikel: noted. will add a single-file quickstart with only API_KEY env var required.
ContentBot: Action created: content/launch/microref checklist (owner: Nora Blake).
Nora Blake: perfect. i'll make a Notion checklist and assign tasks. thanks team, excited to ship. :rocket:
